Third-party 3D models used in Duel: Genesis (Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 - https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

"Dragon Gate Inn with Neon" by daydev
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/dragon-gate-inn-with-neon-6245309e652144bdb91b2d6188b18b11
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, rescaled, materials converted to URP, used as the front of the Genesis Card Shop.

"Sci-fi bar" by onerockett
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/sci-fi-bar-ab88353d0e7148eba5fc0f94853100d0
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, rescaled, materials converted to URP, used inside the Genesis Card Shop.

"SkateBoard Free Model" by marcos.driguez
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/skateboard-free-model-5fb8302331154d0b80e7aa9352a3b664
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, simplified (858k -> 77k triangles), textures resized to 2K, materials converted to URP; used as the rideable skateboard.

"Pot of Greed (Yu-Gi-Oh!)" by Graveyart
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/pot-of-greed-yu-gi-oh-27a0d7d3228747bc86252b70ae1bf0ee
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, simplified (200k -> 75k triangles), textures resized, materials converted to URP;
  used as the Pot of Greed spell animation in duels and as the player's pet.

"Magical Hats (Yugioh)" by Anthony Yanez
  https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/magical-hats-yugioh-f1db1e4859eb488c8caedc6710d3a9d1
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, one hat separated and stood upright, materials converted to URP;
  used as the Magical Hats trap animation in duels.

"Cherry Blossom Trees" by Jagobo
  https://sketchfab.com/Jagobo
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, split into three trees, simplified into two LODs, textures resized, materials converted to URP;
  used as the sakura in the Japanese garden, the parks and the forest edge.

"HGU_Chinatown" by s_sugie (suzy_jpn)
  https://sketchfab.com/suzy_jpn
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, the street row split into seven houses and simplified, textures resized, materials converted to URP;
  used for Chinatown Street and shop-house rows round the city.

"Country shop" by suvorovtim
  https://sketchfab.com/suvorovtim
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, textures resized, materials converted to URP; used for the three country card shops.

"Tokyo Tower/Japanese Radio Tower" by zebadiahsantos
  https://sketchfab.com/zebadiahsantos
  Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
  Changes: converted from glTF to OBJ, earth plinth removed, rescaled to 110 m, materials converted to URP;
  used as the Tokyo Tower landmark beside Genesis Plaza.
